exam.title: Mathematics I - Exam A
exam.subtitle: Linear Algebra and Algebra Basics
exam.instructions: Complete all tasks and show your work. Permitted aids: non-programmable calculator.

exercises.title: Polar Form and Powers
exercises.description:
Let $z = 1 - \sqrt{3}i$.

a) Write $z$ in polar form.
b) Compute $z^5$.
solutionSteps:
Step 1: Modulus and argument
$|z| = \sqrt{1^2 + (\sqrt{3})^2} = 2$
Argument: $\varphi = -\pi/3$ (fourth quadrant)

exercises.title: Determinant and Solving
solutionSteps:
Step 2: Solve the system
From $y + 4z = 2$ we get $y = 2 - 4z$
From $2x + z = 3$ we get $x = (3 - z)/2$

Step 3: Substitute into the first equation
$(3 - z)/2 + 2(2 - 4z) + 3z = 1 \Rightarrow z = 9/11$

exercises.title: Subspace, Basis, Dimension
exercises.description:
Let $U = \{(x,y,z,w) \in \mathbb{R}^4 : x+y+z+w=0,\ 2x-y+w=0\}$.

a) Show that $U$ is a subspace.
b) Find a basis and the dimension.
solutionSteps:
Step 1: Subspace criterion
$U$ is defined by homogeneous linear equations, hence it is a subspace of $\mathbb{R}^4$.

Step 2: Parametrization
From $2x-y+w=0$ we get $y=2x+w$.
Insert into $x+y+z+w=0$: $3x+z+2w=0 \Rightarrow z=-3x-2w$

exercises.title: Diagonalization of a 2×2 Matrix
exercises.description:
Given $B = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 \end{pmatrix}$.

a) Find eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
b) Provide a diagonalization.

exercises.title: Subgroup in $\mathbb{Z}_8$
exercises.description:
Consider the group $(\mathbb{Z}_8,+)$.

a) Determine the subgroup generated by 6.
b) Give the order of the subgroup.
c) Is the subgroup cyclic?
solutionSteps:
Step 3: Order and cyclicity
Order = 4.
The subgroup is cyclic since it is generated by 6.

exercises.title: Kernel and Image
exercises.description:
Let $T: \mathbb{R}^3 \to \mathbb{R}^3$, $T(x,y,z) = (x+y,\ y+z,\ x+z)$.

a) Determine the matrix of $T$.
b) Determine $\ker(T)$ and $\mathrm{rank}(T)$.
c) Describe the image.
solutionSteps:
Step 3: Rank and image
$\det([T])=2\ne0$, so rank $=3$
Image $= \mathbb{R}^3$
